question.text: Which of the following is more basic than aniline?

solution.text: As lone pair of electrons over N-atom of <math><mtext>N</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>H</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> in benzylamine are not directly attached to the benzene ring. So, are not available for the resonance. Thus, benzylamine is more basic than aniline.
